newsitem.title: USA: Tubby's sets expansion restaurant plan.
newsitem.headline: Tubby's sets expansion restaurant plan.

text.p: Tubby's Inc, a specialty sandwich chain, said it plans to open 75 new stores over the next five to 10 years in Texas, initially in the Dallas/Fort Worth area.
The first store is set to open during the fall of this year.

In addition, the company said a development agreement was signed with a sub-franchisor that will expand the Tubby's Sub Shop concept into Canada for the first time. The agreement provides for 30 stores to be opened over the next five years in the provinces of Alberta and British Columbia.
The first store will open next month in Edmonton, followed by stores in Calgary and Vancouver.
Established in 1968, Tubby's has shops located in Michigan, Ohio, Arizona and Pennsylvania.
